description: Judge and improve the quality of robot-learning datasets (teleoperated demonstrations, episodes) and use forge, the Robotics Data Toolkit, to inspect, lint, score, visualise, filter, dedup, and convert them. Use this skill when the user mentions dataset quality, data cleaning or curation, episode inspection, bad or noisy demos, idle frames, jerky or spiky actions, gripper chatter, timestamp gaps or frame drops, camera blur or exposure, duplicate episodes, task-string hygiene, normalisation stats, train/val splits by episode, coverage or diversity of demonstrations, or why a policy will not start, stalls, or averages modes because of its data. Also trigger on forge commands (forge inspect, lint, stats, quality, filter, dedup, visualize, convert, catalog, ingest, curate) and on conversion between RLDS, LeRobot v2/v3, Zarr, HDF5, MCAP, rosbag, or RoboDM, including hf:// datasets on the Hugging Face Hub.
